AccessKit ↗

A small tool for getting unstuck.

TRANSPARENT BY DESIGN

Clarity you can inspect.

AccessKit uses local, rule-based extraction to identify phrases about requirements, eligibility, costs, access details, and dates. It is not a language model and does not decide whether you qualify.

Every output preserves the original sentence. Rules can miss information or group it incorrectly. Always read the original source. Different deadline dates are flagged for review, not automatically declared a contradiction.

The text never leaves your browser through this app. Saving on this device is optional; clearing it removes AccessKit’s saved workspace. Hosting providers may still receive ordinary page request information.

Calendar exports are all-day reminders, not authoritative closing times. Fictional examples use example.org addresses.
